changelog: RESUME NO LONGER DESTROYS THE RUN IT OFFERS TO CONTINUE. Play a Daily Commission, abandon it for an ordinary campaign, come back to the menu — the Daily button read “resume”, and pressing it wiped the campaign in progress and started the day over. It now resumes, and only offers to when the saved run really is that Commission. YOU CAN READ THE RULES YOU ARE PLAYING UNDER. A Commission's modifiers were invisible once the run started: no sign they were on, and nothing saying what they did — so a troop cap of 4 had no explanation anywhere. Settings now has Run details, listing every modifier, ascension tier and Commission exception together with what each one actually does. The Daily standings are reachable from the Commission panel too, instead of only appearing after you finish a run. And Reset all progress has moved in with the debug tools, where it belongs.
